description: This file defines platform-specific abstractions and utilities for the Playwright core library, including platform info, environment handling, stream interfaces, and zone management.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: An interface for managing execution zones with push, pop, run, and data retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: An interface representing platform-specific functions and properties, such as environment handling, file streaming, and configuration.

methods.name: boxedStackPrefixes
methods.description: Returns an array of string prefixes used for stack frame boxing.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Calculates the SHA1 hash of a given text asynchronously.

methods.name: defaultMaxListeners
methods.description: Returns the default maximum number of event listeners.

methods.name: streamFile
methods.description: Streams a file from a given path into a writable stream.

methods.name: streamReadable
methods.description: Creates a Readable stream from a channel.

methods.name: streamWritable
methods.description: Creates a Writable stream from a channel.
